name: Metricool Social Media Management
description:
Metricool connects Claude to your social media accounts, letting you schedule and manage posts across 13 networks — including Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Bluesky, and Threads. Get AI-powered best time to post recommendations based on your historical data, pull detailed analytics and reports on followers, reach, engagement, and impressions, manage Facebook and TikTok Ads performance, and handle multiple brands and accounts — all through natural conversation. Analyze competitors, get insights, create content and schedule to be published directly on Social Media. 

You can also use Claude Code to generate carousels and assets and send it directly to Social Media Platforms. 

Automate your tasks, for better Social Media Management.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Metricool Social Media Management to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Metricool Social Media Management to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai.metricool.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Metricool Social Media Management MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metricool Social Media Management provides these MCP tools: createScheduledPost, getAnalyticsAvailableMetrics, getAnalyticsDataByMetrics, getBestTimeToPostByNetwork, getBrandSettings, getScheduledPosts, and updateScheduledPost.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Metricool Social Media Management?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Metricool Social Media Management in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Metricool Social Media Management MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metricool Social Media Management requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Metricool Social Media Management?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metricool Social Media Management is developed by Metricool. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
